convert_pytorch_to_caffe2: convert a PyTorch ResNet model to Caffe2 format using --pth_model and --output_model arguments
rename_resnet_weights: rename PyTorch ResNet weight keys to Caffe2-compatible naming conventions using _rename_weights_for_resnet
load_pytorch_weights: load PyTorch pickled model weights from a file path using _load_pth_pickled_weights
convert_bgr_to_rgb: convert conv1 weights from BGR to RGB channel order using convert_bgr2rgb
save_pickle_object: atomically save a Python object to a pickle file using save_object with temp file safety
